search_log: Listed BMY (CIK 0000014272) 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K, 10-K/A, 10-Q/A filings from data.sec.gov submissions (recent + older pages): 3534 filings of all forms, 1994-2026

Selected 8-K/8-K/A with item 2.02 filed 2006-2026 (96 filings); cross-checked against 10-Q/10-K filing dates: every quarter's 10-Q/10-K has a 2.02 earnings 8-K within 10 days except the Q1 2014 release (8-K 0000014272-14-000172, item 9.01 only), which was added by hand; 10-K filings sit weeks after the Q4 releases so those matched the January/February releases
Fetched each filing's index.json and downloaded all EX-99.x exhibits; extraction script scripts/extract.py reads the first labelled product row of each EX-99.1 and scripts/audit2.py cross-checks it
8-K/A filings of 2006-2008 (restated EX-99.2 schedules) were not used as sources; each quarter is cited from its own original EX-99.1

Audit: 244 prior-year-column comparisons across the five products (each release's prior-year figure vs the value taken from that quarter's own release) had 0 mismatches; 61 fourth-quarter FY-sum checks (four quarters vs the FY figure in the Q4 release) had 0 mismatches
